symbols.name: fractional precision
symbols.meaning: The number of fractional binary places kept, so the grid spacing is $2^{-p}$.
symbols.quote: Let $p$ be the number of fractional binary places kept.

symbols.name: truncation to precision p
symbols.meaning: The operator that truncates each real and imaginary coefficient part of an array toward zero to the grid $2^{-p}\mathbb{Z}$.
symbols.quote: For an array $z$ of complex coefficients, $Q_p z$ is the array obtained by truncating each real and imaginary coefficient part to the grid $2^{-p}\mathbb{Z}$, the set of multiples of $2^{-p}$.

symbols.name: input array
symbols.meaning: An array of complex coefficients that is truncated by $Q_p$.
symbols.quote: For an array $z$ of complex coefficients, $Q_p z$ is the array obtained by truncating each real and imaginary coefficient part to the grid $2^{-p}\mathbb{Z}$, the set of multiples of $2^{-p}$.
